_comment: The key set an issuer publishes at /v1/keyset, as an operator configures it and as it is served. Keys are listed in the order they became active; the first is the anchor; each later key carries introduced_by, the composite signature of the key before it over the canonical JSON of {ctx: 'aria-keyset-introduction-v1', key_id, suite, public_key_mldsa65, public_key_ed25519, active_from}; only the last key is active (active_until null). fingerprint is 'sha256:' and the hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of {key_id, suite, public_key_mldsa65, public_key_ed25519}. A verifier trusts the key whose fingerprint it pinned out of band; publication grants nothing. The gateway serving these test keys verifies with the active key. Synthetic keys derived from public labels.

refused.label: the first key carries an introduction
a later key without an introduction
an introduction by the key itself
an introduction signed over another start
the introduced key replaced after signing
a suite other than the composite one
a member the format does not define
the active key is not the one the gateway verifies with
an active window that ends before it starts
